title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: new health signals in the Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, Android signal descriptions, licensing and control paths are supported. The webhook wizard's Endpoint configuration heading is documented in the cited authentication guide, and independent searches found no published default for the new signals or automation for the three controls.
